mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT M.* FROM SPECTRA.SYS_MENU M INNER JOIN SPECTRA.SYS_REL_ROLE_MENU RM ON M.ID = RM.MENU_ID INNER JOIN SPECTRA.SYS_REL_USER_ROLE UR ON RM.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.DELETED IS NULL AND RM.DELETED IS NULL AND UR.DELETED IS NULL ORDER BY M.SORT;
